title: 第四章 请决死
content_zh:
姜望话音方落，毫不犹豫拔剑便斩。
“什、什么！？”
寒光乍现，方鹏举连滚带爬避开这一剑，惊怒之极，也狼狈之极。
除此之外，在场竟无一人反应过来。几乎所有人都以为下一幕会是兄弟和解，情义深重，甚至传为一时佳话。
谁也没有想到，有众人瞩目，兄弟之情裹挟，姜望竟还真的会出剑！
“鹏举。”姜望嘴角含笑地看着他，但那笑容却格外冰冷，“说好的引颈待戮，你怎么躲了？”
方鹏举俊脸阵青阵白，索性从地上站起来，咬牙与他对视：“三哥，你果真不顾一点兄弟之情吗？”
“无耻的混账王八蛋！”到了这个时候，杜野虎已经怒不可遏，“老子瞎了眼才跟你做兄弟！”
他说着，提步便要冲过来，但被姜望伸手拦住。
“二哥，这事让我自己处理。”
方鹏举怒目而视：“杜野虎！这有你什么事！？”
“方鹏举，你太令我失望了！”向来宽厚的凌河也按不住怒色，他踏前一步，拔出腰侧配剑，将一角衣袍割下，重重扔在地上，“自今而后，你我割袍断义！”
“大哥！”方鹏举惨笑一声：“二哥为人冲动也就罢了，连你也不能理解我吗？为证清白我甘愿一死，可我父母就我这一个儿子，我是他们唯一的香火，死都放不下的希望！我的命不是自己的，怎么能死在这里？姜望妄信奸人，不听解释，一心置我于死地！他心中可有兄弟之情义在？”
“四哥，这是我最后一次叫你四哥，”枫林五侠中年龄最小的赵汝成终于出声。他面容稍有稚色但已极为俊美，此刻说话，竟如金玉，落地有声：“方得财姓方！世代服侍你方家！一群败匪能拿出什么条件收买他？你是在侮辱你方家的财势，还是在侮辱我们大家的智慧？西山一群败家之犬，又是怎么混进的枫林城并且还能在望月楼堂然设下陷阱？最后，既然你没有以死明志的决心，方才这一番惺惺作态，又是演给谁看？我赵汝成耻与你为伍！”
五人中凌河与姜望家贫，杜野虎家境不好不坏，而方鹏举和赵汝成都是富贵公子。方家自不必说，赵家虽然近十年才迁来枫林城，但家底深不可测。
“小五，你向来与老三交好，平日偏向他也就罢了，可我难道就不是你四哥？你毫无证据，只凭推断就说这些诛心之语，难道就良心能安吗？”
方鹏举痛心疾首，显得煎熬受伤已极。
“鹏举你仍然辩才无碍。”姜望止住赵汝成等人，“但是你有没有想过，为什么之前我即使重伤逃遁，也没有暗中联系大哥二哥小五，而是选择直到今天才来找你？”
他眼皮微垂：“因为我从来就不愿意让他们做什么选择，不想让他们猜疑，不想让他们为难！你和我之间的事情，就你和我自己来解决。我若死了，那便死了。既然我还活着，那么该还的，你得还给我。”
关注公众号：书友大本营，关注即送现金、点币！

方鹏举冷眼看着他：“你是不是有被迫害的臆想？我并不欠你什么，你又叫我怎么还？你为什么执迷不悟？”
但姜望已不再与他对话，而是转身对着道院中那尊高大的道尊雕像遥遥拜倒：“弟子姜望，遭奸人方鹏举所害，险些身故。此仇无可解，此恨无可消。请与之决死！”
场下哗然。
道证死斗！！！
同门相杀是罪，但若真有生死大恨、血仇难消，道门也不忌讳决斗这种事。
而在诸多种决斗中，请道尊见证的决斗也是最无可挽回的一种。
道门普遍认为，道尊髙卧九天，洞察宇宙。诵念其名，即为所知。拜服其形，即为所感。所有誓言一旦涉及道尊，则便无可挽回。
道证死斗，不死不休。
姜望话音刚落，便有一黑袍中年道士出现在道尊雕像前。
他面容沉毅，留有短须。黑色道袍右胸绣有一条小小青龙，望之竟栩栩如生。这是只有中三品强者才能穿的腾龙道袍。
世俗修者，境界大致分为九品。各流派或者名称不同，也有不同的超凡体现，但大致品阶都能从九品制上对应。九至七品为初阶，六至四品为中阶，三至一品为高阶。有趣的是，这同时也对应了各国的官品。
当然，如庄国这样的小国，即使是一品丞相，也未必真有一品的实力了。
这黑袍短须道人甫一现身，在场所有弟子全都躬身行礼，“院长！”
整个枫林城也没有几个能穿腾龙黑袍的道人，这其中就包括了枫林道院的院长董阿。相传他曾在庄国国都新安城修行过，因为方正秉公的性格，得罪权贵，才被外放到清河郡枫林城来。
凌河面带哀色，但却不发一言。他深知姜望的剑术，可以说在正式开始修行道术之前，外院中无人是其对手，方鹏举也不例外。
但姜望既然提出道证决斗，表示冤屈无解。此时院长亲至，方鹏举要么拼死一搏，要么只能束手等枫林道院介入调查姜望被暗算之事。
然而方鹏举哪里经得起道院调查？
因而事实上他并没有选择。
在无数或猜疑或讥嘲或气愤的目光中，方鹏举面上仍不见慌乱，“三哥，你我真要拔剑面对彼此？”
姜望淡淡道：“让我们走到如今之境地的，是你，不是我。”

“你要怎样才肯信我？”
“我已经为这份信任付出过一次生命，现在，多说无益，我印象中的方鹏举，不是不敢应战的懦夫。”
方鹏举不为所动：“你就那么自信能够杀了我？”
姜望平静地看着他：“不妨一试。”
方鹏举注视了他半晌，忽然哈哈一笑：“可惜你杀不了我，我们的决斗无法成立。因为就在前日，我已道脉初显，可以说已经是内院弟子！你我层次不同，如何决斗？”
他说着站直身躯，全力激发道脉，在场的人都可以感知到，有一股气势自他脊柱大龙升起，令他精神蓬勃而起。这说明他已显现道脉，肉身可以反馈道脉诞生道元，正式拥有超凡力量。
道院对决斗早有相应规定，其中很重要的一点是，对于不同层级间的决斗邀请，任何人都可以无条件拒绝。这是为了保护低品修者，使其避免高品修者借此欺辱。但在此时，变成了方鹏举逃避决斗的理由。
他虽然显现了道脉，但时日未久，更没有开始修习道术，因此力量并没有本质的提升，故而仍没有与姜望交战的把握。
姜望沉默了。
他沉默地看着方鹏举，情绪复杂。
而后缓缓说道：“为了这颗开脉丹，我单剑闯入西山，浴血奋战，方才击破贼巢。此战，我身中十三创，有两处致命伤。”
“为了开脉能达到最好的效果，我准备等身体恢复到巅峰状态再用此丹。怀璧其罪的道理我懂，因而我不曾对任何人透露口风。所有人都以为我当天就会吞服丹药，除了你，除了我们这五个出生入死的兄弟。因为我没有任何事情，需要对你们隐瞒。”
“从五岁那年我接触了修行的世界开始，我就在追逐这颗开脉丹。我没有天生道脉外显，要想超凡只能依靠丹药。它是我的修行路，是我的希望，是我唯一的光。你是知道我的家庭情况的，你是知道我有多努力的。我每日天没亮就起来练剑，月上中天才去休息。我从来不去青楼妓馆，也从不以任何方式放纵自己。整个枫林道院，我敢说没有任何一个外门弟子比我更努力。为了这颗开脉丹，我努力了整整十一年！”
姜望说着，也死死地盯着方鹏举，“和着我的汗我的血我的泪，我的这样的开脉丹，好用么？”
场内一时寂静。
凌河嘴唇抿紧，赵汝成咬牙不语，甚至于杜野虎这样的汉子竟也红了眼睛。
是啊，他们谁不知道姜望的痴、姜望的累、姜望的苦？
而方鹏举，竟然狠得下这种心来！
“我不知道你在胡说什么！”方鹏举脸上闪过一丝不自然，但很快被他强压下去，“我伯父上旬带商队经行云国，恰巧从一位手头拮据的修者那里买回了一颗开脉丹，我因此得以道脉外显，与你又有什么相干？不要以为谁都像你一样出身低贫，为求奋进不择手段！我方家家财万贯，难道就买不起一颗开脉丹吗？”
赵汝成已是恨极，说话不再收敛词锋：“是啊，方家的确家财万贯。可惜你父母早逝，你又不是方家嫡脉独苗，分配给你的家族资源更是有限。不然，怎么这么长的时间，你都没能拥有开脉丹，却又这么巧，在我三哥遇袭之后就有了呢？”

“那还真是巧合。我只能说，太巧了！”方鹏举眸现寒光：“没有证据的事情不要再说，看在我们兄弟一场的份上，我不与你们计较。再有下次，成为内院弟子的我，会让你们知道什么叫尊卑有序！”
“你！”赵汝成怒极。
杜野虎更是咬碎钢牙，要不是院长在场，他恨不得一拳捣烂方鹏举那张俊脸。
唯独姜望，反倒显得平静：“方鹏举，我告诉过你的。你太傲慢，太自以为是，也常常因此忽略真相。我教过你的，为什么你就是教不会呢？”
“你为什么不想想，如果道证决斗不能够成立，那么董院长又为什么会出现在这里？”
他上前一步，同样激发道脉，脊柱大龙中的那条蚯蚓激烈游动起来，整个人像剑一样锐利，像剑一样挺直！
“那是因为，我也已经显现道脉，正式拥有了超凡可能啊！”
“我们层次相同，你又不敢让院长调查。因而，决斗成立！”
方鹏举大惊失色的同时，院长董阿已经挥开大袖。
就在道院门口，就在姜望方鹏举两人脚下，忽然一颗树苗破土而出，在几息内就疯狂生长起来，长成一个巨大木桩，将两人托起，而将其他外院弟子都隔在外面。
木桩顶部似被利器削过一般平整，十步见方。远远看去，便是一个木质圆形高台。只是在“高台”四周，有枝丫摇曳。
方鹏举毫不怀疑，一旦自己转身逃跑，这些看似人畜无害的枝丫便会化成噬人恶兽。
而姜望的手已经按在剑柄上，蓄势待发。
董阿随手一招，一根枝条扭动着将方鹏举之前丢在地上的剑卷起，甩上高台。
方鹏举伸手接住。
在永远无法看清面容的道尊雕像前，五品内府境强者董阿，漠声宣布：“道证死斗，开始！”
content_en:
As soon as Jiang Wang finished speaking, he drew his sword and struck with no hesitation.
"W-What!?"
The cold light suddenly appeared, and Fang Pengju rolled and crawled to avoid the sword. He was extremely frightened, angry, and embarrassed.
Other than that, no one present reacted. Almost everyone thought that the next scene would be a reconciliation between brothers, a deep friendship, and even became a good story.
No one thought that with the attention of everyone and the love of brotherhood, Jiang Wang would actually be able to draw a sword!
"Peng Ju." Jiang Wang looked at him with a smile on his face, but his smile was extremely cold, "We promised to wait for the kill, why did you hide?"
Fang Pengju's handsome face turned green and white. He simply stood up from the ground, gritted his teeth and looked at him: "Third brother, do you really don't care about brotherhood?"
"Shameless bastard!" By this time, Du Yehu was furious, "I am blind to be your brother!"
As he said this, he was about to rush over, but Jiang Wang reached out to stop him.
"Second brother, let me handle this matter myself."
Fang Pengju glared angrily: "Du Yehu! What does this have to do with you!?"
"Fang Pengju, you disappoint me so much!" Ling He, who has always been kind and generous, couldn't hold back his anger. He took a step forward, pulled out the sword at his waist, cut off a corner of his robe, and threw it heavily on the ground, "From now on, we will cut off our robes to end our relationship!"
"Brother!" Fang Pengju laughed miserably: "Second brother is just an impulsive person. Can't you even understand me? I am willing to die to prove my innocence, but my parents are the only son. I am their only incest, and they can't let go of hope! My life is not my own, how can I die here? Jiang Wang believed in a traitor, refused to listen to explanations, and wanted to kill me! Does he have brotherly love in his heart?"
"Fourth Brother, this is the last time I call you Fourth Brother," Zhao Rucheng, the youngest of the Five Heroes of Maplewoods, finally spoke up. His face was a little childish but extremely handsome. At this moment, his words were like gold and jade, and he spoke loudly: "Fang Decai's surname is Fang! I have served your Fang family for generations! What conditions can a group of defeated gangsters offer to bribe him? Are you insulting your Fang family's wealth, or are you insulting all of us? Wisdom? How did a group of prodigal dogs from Xishan sneak into Maplewood City and set up a trap in Wangyue Pavilion? Finally, since you are not determined to show your ambition through death, who are you showing off to me, Zhao Ru? "
Among the five, Ling He and Jiang Wang were from poor families, Du Yehu was from a good or not bad family, and Fang Pengju and Zhao Rucheng were both wealthy young men. Needless to say, the Fang family, although the Zhao family only moved to Maplewood City in the past ten years, their family background is unfathomable.
"Xiaowu, you have always been on good terms with the third child, and it's okay to favor him on weekdays. But am I not your fourth brother? You have no evidence and only rely on inferences to say these heart-wrenching words. Can your conscience be at ease?"
Fang Pengju was heartbroken and looked extremely hurt.
"Pengju, you are still fine with your eloquence." Jiang Wang stopped Zhao Rucheng and others, "But have you ever thought about why I didn't secretly contact my eldest brother, second brother, and Xiaowu even though I was seriously injured and escaped, but chose not to come to you until today?"
His eyelids drooped slightly: "Because I never want to let them make a choice, don't want them to be suspicious, and don't want to make them embarrassed! The matter between you and me is up to you and me to resolve. If I die, then I will die. Since I am still alive, you have to return what is due to me."
Follow the public account: Book Friends Base Camp, follow and you will receive cash and coins!
Fang Pengju looked at him coldly: "Do you have any thoughts of being persecuted? I don't owe you anything, so why do you ask me to pay you back? Why are you so stubborn?"
But Jiang Wang no longer talked to him. Instead, he turned around and bowed down to the tall Taoist statue in the Taoist courtyard: "Disciple Jiang Wang was harmed by the traitor Fang Pengju and almost died. This hatred cannot be resolved and this hatred cannot be eliminated. Please fight to the death!"
The audience was in an uproar.
Daozheng fight to the death! ! !
Killing each otherIt is a sin, but if there is a real hatred of life and death and a blood feud that cannot be eliminated, the Taoist sect will not shy away from such things as duels.
Among all kinds of duels, the duel witnessed by Dao Zun is also the most irreversible one.
Taoist sects generally believe that Tao Zun lies high in the nine heavens and has insight into the universe. Recite its name and you will know it. Admire its shape and feel it. All oaths are irreversible once they involve Tao Zun.
Dao Zheng fights to the death and fights to the death.
As soon as Jiang Wang finished speaking, a middle-aged Taoist priest in black robe appeared in front of the Taoist statue.
He has a serious face and a short beard. There is a small green dragon embroidered on the right chest of the black Taoist robe, which looks lifelike. This is the Tenglong Taoist robe that can only be worn by strong men of the third level.
The realm of secular cultivators is roughly divided into nine levels. Each school or name is different, and there are also different extraordinary manifestations, but the general grades can all correspond to the nine-grade system. Ranks nine to seven are the initial level, grades six to four are the intermediate level, and grades three to one are the high level. Interestingly, this also corresponds to the official titles of various countries.
Of course, in a small country like Zhuang State, even a first-grade prime minister may not really have the strength of a first-grade prime minister.
As soon as this black-robed and short-bearded Taoist appeared, all the disciples present bowed and saluted, "Dean!"
There are few Taoists in the entire Maplewood City who can wear Tenglong's black robe, including Dong A, the dean of Maplewood Taoist Academy. According to legend, he once practiced in Xin'an City, the capital of the Zhuang Kingdom. Because of his upright and impartial character, he offended the powerful, so he was sent to Fenglin City in Qinghe County.
Ling He looked sad, but didn't say a word. He was well aware of Jiang Wang's swordsmanship. It could be said that before he officially started practicing Taoism, no one in the outer courtyard was his opponent, and Fang Pengju was no exception.
But since Jiang Wang proposed a Tao Zheng duel, he expressed that his grievances had no solution. At this time, the dean arrived in person, and Fang Pengju could either fight to the death or wait for Fenglin Taoist Academy to intervene in the investigation of Jiang Wang's plot.
However, how could Fang Pengju withstand the investigation of the Taoist Academy?
So in fact he had no choice.
Amid countless suspicious, ridiculing or angry looks, Fang Pengju still showed no panic on his face, "Third brother, do you and I really want to draw our swords and face each other?"
Jiang Wang said calmly: "It was you, not me, who brought us to where we are now."
"What do you have to do to trust me?"
"I have already given my life once for this trust. Now, it is useless to say more. In my impression, Fang Pengju is not a coward who dare not take up the challenge."
Fang Pengju was unmoved: "Are you so confident that you can kill me?"
Jiang Wang looked at him calmly: "You might as well give it a try."
Fang Pengju stared at him for a long time, and suddenly laughed: "It's a pity that you can't kill me, and our duel cannot be established. Because just the day before yesterday, I had my Taoist veins first revealed, and it can be said that I am already a disciple of the inner courtyard! You and I are at different levels, how can we duel?"
As he spoke, he stood up straight and activated his Tao channels with all his strength. Everyone present could feel that there was a momentum rising from the dragon on his spine, making him energetic. This shows that he has manifested the Tao Veins, and his physical body can feed back the Tao Veins to give birth to Tao Yuan, and he officially possesses extraordinary power.
The Taoist Academy has long had corresponding regulations on duels, and a very important point is that anyone can unconditionally refuse invitations to duels between different levels. This is to protect low-quality practitioners from being bullied by high-quality practitioners. But at this time, it became Fang Pengju's reason to avoid the duel.
Although he showed his Taoist veins, it had not been long ago and he had not started to practice Taoism. Therefore, his power had not been substantially improved, so he was still not sure of fighting Jiang Wang.
Jiang Wang fell silent.
He looked at Fang Pengju in silence, with mixed emotions.
Then he slowly said: "For this Pulse Opening Pill, I broke into the Western Mountain with my single sword and fought bloody battles before breaking through the thieves' nest. In this battle, I suffered thirteen wounds on my body, including two fatal injuries."
"In order to achieve the best effect of opening the pulse, I plan to wait until my body returns to its peak condition before using this elixir. I understand the reason why holding a jade is a crime, so I have never revealed it to anyone. Everyone.Everyone thought I would swallow the elixir that day, except you, except us five brothers who have been through life and death. Because I have nothing that I need to hide from you. "
“Ever since I came into contact with the world of spiritual practice when I was five years old, I have been chasing this pulse-opening pill. I don't have any natural Dao channels, so I can only rely on elixirs to become extraordinary. It is my spiritual path, my hope, and my only light. You know my family situation, and you know how hard I work. I get up before dawn every day to practice swordplay, and only go to rest in the middle of the moon. I never went to brothels or indulged myself in any way. In the entire Fenglin Taoist Academy, I dare say that there is no outer disciple who works harder than me. I have worked hard for this pulse-opening pill for eleven years! "
Jiang Wang said, staring at Fang Pengju, "With my sweat, my blood, my tears, is my pulse-opening pill easy to use? "
There was silence for a moment.
Ling He pursed his lips tightly, Zhao Rucheng gritted his teeth and remained silent, and even a man like Du Yehu turned red.
Yes, who among them doesn't know Jiang Wang's madness, Jiang Wang's tiredness, and Jiang Wang's suffering?
But Fang Pengju was so ruthless!
"I don't know what you're talking about! A trace of uneasiness flashed across Fang Pengju's face, but he quickly suppressed it, "My uncle led a caravan through the Yun Kingdom last month, and he happened to buy back a pulse-opening pill from a cultivator who was strapped for money. As a result, I was able to reveal my Dao veins. What does it have to do with you?" Don’t think that everyone comes from a poor background like you and will do whatever it takes to make progress! Our family has a lot of money, can’t we afford a pulse-opening pill? "
Zhao Rucheng was filled with hatred and no longer restrained his words: "Yes, the Fang family is indeed extremely wealthy. It's a pity that your parents died young. You are not the only direct descendant of the Fang family, and the family resources allocated to you are even more limited. Otherwise, why have you not been able to possess the Pulse Opening Pill for such a long time, but it was such a coincidence that you had it after my third brother was attacked? "
“That’s quite a coincidence. All I can say is, what a coincidence! Fang Peng raised his eyes with a cold light: "Don't talk about things without evidence. For the sake of our brothers, I won't argue with you." Next time, as a disciple of the inner court, I will let you know what it means to be in an orderly manner! "
"you! "Zhao Rucheng was extremely angry.
Du Yehu gritted his steel teeth to pieces. If the dean hadn't been present, he would have wanted to punch Fang Pengju's handsome face into pieces.
